name: Inbox folder indexer
description: Drop files into workspace/inbox and they're automatically indexed into document search (then a notification confirms it). The simplest event-driven flow — shows: file-watch trigger, index_docs. Baselines persist across restarts, so files dropped while Oceano was down still index on startup.

args.title: 📚 Docs indexed
args.message: workspace/inbox changed — its documents were re-indexed for search.
